Risk Description: Double booking of the same seat when requests arrive at the same time
Mitigation Strategy: Make the seat hold one atomic database operation (transaction or row lock) and run concurrency tests

Risk Description: Frequent requirement changes (coupons, cancellation rules, new payment modes)
Mitigation Strategy: Formal change control: every change is logged, estimated and approved before work starts; freeze requirements during a sprint

Risk Description: Payment gateway outage or failed callback (money deducted but no ticket issued)
Mitigation Strategy: Use an established PCI-compliant gateway with an SLA so payment processing and card-data liability sit with the provider; add retries and a daily reconciliation job

Risk Description: Security vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, weak login or exposed customer data
Mitigation Strategy: Parameterised queries, password hashing, HTTPS, role-based access, security code review and testing before release; never store card data

Risk Description: Loss of source code or project documents
Mitigation Strategy: Keep all artifacts in Git with a remote repository on GitHub or GitLab; protect the main branch; commit daily

Risk Description: Project completion delayed beyond the semester deadline
Mitigation Strategy: Break work into weekly milestones, track progress on a task board and review it every week

Risk Description: Slow response at peak booking time (new-release weekend); 3-second target missed
Mitigation Strategy: Cache show and seat-map data, add database indexes and run load tests before release

Risk Description: Inadequate testing leaves defects in the booking and payment flow
Mitigation Strategy: Write test cases from the SRS (equivalence, boundary and path testing) and run regression tests on every merge
Cross-train two people on every module and keep documentation current in the repository

Risk Description: Integration failures between the booking, payment and notification services
Mitigation Strategy: Define interface contracts early, integrate every week and run integration tests with a mock gateway

Risk Description: E-mail or SMS provider failure, so e-tickets are not delivered
Mitigation Strategy: Accept the risk: the e-ticket is also shown on the booking history page, so no extra development is needed
Automated daily backups with a tested restore; use transactions for all booking writes

Risk Description: Hosting or tool costs exceed the budget
Mitigation Strategy: Avoid the cost: use an open-source stack and free-tier hosting, with no paid licences

Risk Description: Refund and cancellation rules are left undefined, causing rework
Mitigation Strategy: Change the plan: release 1 supports only a full refund before a fixed cut-off; partial refunds are deferred; get written approval

Risk Description: Minor UI differences across browsers and phones
Mitigation Strategy: Accept the risk: test on the two main browsers only and log cosmetic issues for later
